explainer.summary: What is this? Deadlines, statuses and who can act
explainer.intro: Users have the right to ask CatCheck to let them view or export, correct, delete or pause the processing of their personal data, to withdraw consent, or to file a complaint. This screen is the queue of those requests, including ones users submit in the app and ones an admin creates on their behalf.
explainer.acronym: Technical documents call this a DSAR (Data Subject Access Request).
explainer.typesTitle: Request types, deadlines and what to do
explainer.deadlineAck: Acknowledge receipt: within 2 business days of intake.
explainer.deadlineFulfil: Complete: 10, 15 or 20 calendar days from intake, depending on type (see table above).
explainer.deadlineExtend: A request can be extended exactly once and a reason is required. The new deadline must be after the old one and add no more than the original period (for example, a 10-day deadline can be extended by at most 10 more days).
explainer.deadlineOverdue: A request that is not closed and is past its deadline (including any extended deadline) counts as overdue.
explainer.roleSupport: Support admin: view requests, Acknowledge receipt and Take on.
explainer.roleSuper: Super Admin: every step (Extend, Complete, Reject) and creating requests on behalf of users.
explainer.roleDpo: DPO (data protection officer): same as Super Admin, and the only one who can approve data deletion.

typeHints.ACCESS_EXPORT: The system builds a file with the user's data and emails a download link. The link can be used only once, within 72 hours. The request moves to Completed automatically when the file is ready.
typeHints.RECTIFY: Correct the user's inaccurate information as requested (manually), then click Complete.
typeHints.ERASE: Deletes the user's activity log, AI assistant conversations and booking notes. Not closed with the Complete button: the DPO must approve the deletion; if an admin created the request on the user's behalf, the approver must be a different person from the creator.
typeHints.RESTRICT: Pause processing of the user's data within the requested scope (manually), then click Complete.
typeHints.OBJECT: Review the grounds for the objection. If valid, stop that processing activity and Complete; if not, Reject with a reason.
typeHints.WITHDRAW_CONSENT: Stop the processing based on the consent the user withdrew, then click Complete.
typeHints.PROTECTION_MEASURE: Apply the data protection measure the user asked for (manually), then click Complete.
typeHints.COMPLAINT: Review the complaint about how CatCheck handles data, reply to the user, then click Complete.

statusHints.RECEIVED: Just received. Tell the user it has been received, click Acknowledge receipt (the system only records the time and does not send an email), then Take on.
statusHints.IDENTITY_PENDING: Data export and account deletion require verifying the account owner before acting. The request waits here until identity is verified.
statusHints.IN_PROGRESS: The assignee is working on it. When done, click Complete, or Reject with a reason.
statusHints.EXTENDED: The deadline has been moved once. It must still be completed before the new deadline.
statusHints.COMPLETED: Done. The request is closed and can no longer change.
statusHints.REJECTED: Rejected with a reason. The request is closed and can no longer change.

transitionHints.ACK: Record the time the user was told their request was received.
transitionHints.ASSIGN: Take the request yourself and move it to In progress (or Awaiting identity verification if the request type requires it).
transitionHints.EXTEND: Move the deadline once only; a reason is required.
transitionHints.COMPLETE: Close the request as done. Cannot be undone.
transitionHints.REJECT: Close the request with a rejection reason. Cannot be undone.

chart.cloneCta: Create a draft from this chart

explainer.title: What is a pH color chart?
explainer.what: The litter bag has a row of printed reference swatches, each matching a pH value. The color chart here stores exactly those swatches: which color means which pH.
explainer.scan: When a user takes a photo, the scanner compares the colors in the photo with the Active chart for the matching product line (and batch) to read the pH. If the chart colors are wrong, the pH reading will be wrong too.
explainer.draft: Work in progress. Freely edit the name, product line, batch and color levels; it affects no one yet.
explainer.active: After publishing. The scanner uses this chart. Each product line + batch has only one Active chart.
explainer.archived: An old chart replaced by a newer one. Kept for reference.
explainer.edit: Only drafts can be edited. To change the colors of an active chart: open it, choose “Create a draft from this chart”, edit it, then publish.

chart.fieldBatchHelp: Leave blank if the chart applies to all batches (the scanner currently uses only this kind). Fill in only when a printed batch has different colors.
chart.fieldCodeHelpVersion: Short code to identify the chart. Reusing an old chart's code creates a new version of that chart.
chart.fieldNameHelp: An easily recognizable name, e.g. “Standard bag – October print batch”.
chart.fieldProductLineHelp: The type of litter bag this color chart is printed on.
chart.invalidHex: Color code must be in #RRGGBB format
chart.listDescription: All statuses. Only drafts can be edited.
chart.metaHelp: Which bag type and batch the chart applies to.
chart.metaScanYes: Using this chart for all scans
chart.placeholderHelp: The colors in this chart were entered temporarily and have not been calibrated against a real litter bag. pH readings using this chart are not reliable until a calibrated chart is published to replace it.
chart.pointsHelp: Each level is a color swatch printed on the bag: pH value, display color and name. Color measurements help the scanner match colors accurately.
chart.pointsIncomplete: Some rows are incomplete. Each level needs all five numbers, a display hex in #RRGGBB format and a Vietnamese display name.
chart.publishBody: The draft becomes the active version and the previously active version is archived. The server rejects it if the chart is missing levels or classification bands.
chart.publishBodyOther: Once published, the chart becomes Active for the selected product line and batch. The scanner currently uses only the Standard line chart with no batch, so this chart will not be used when scanning yet.
chart.publishBodyScan: Once published, the scanner reads the pH of every new scan using this chart, and the chart can no longer be edited.
chart.publishConflict: Chart “{{name}}” (version {{version}}) is currently in use for {{line}} · {{batch}}. Publishing this draft will replace it; the old chart moves to Archived.
chart.publishConsequence: The draft becomes Active for the selected product line and batch, and can no longer be edited afterward.
chart.publishConsequenceReplace: The draft will replace “{{name}}” (version {{version}}); the old chart moves to Archived.
chart.publishConsequenceScan: The draft becomes Active and the scanner reads the pH of every new scan using this chart. It can no longer be edited afterward.
chart.readOnlyNoPermission: You only have permission to view this chart.
chart.readOnlyNote: This chart is not a draft, so it is view-only. The server will reject edits to the active version.
chart.readOnlyPublished: Published or archived charts cannot be edited directly. To adjust colors, create a draft from this chart, edit it, then publish.
chart.saveMetaConsequence: Updates the draft's name, product line and batch. Does not affect scan results yet.
chart.savePointsConsequence: Replaces all of the draft's color levels with the {{count}} levels shown. The draft does not affect scan results yet.
chart.scanCurrentLabel: The scanner is reading pH using chart
chart.scanNone: No color chart is currently active for the scanner (Standard line, no batch). Scans will report a missing color chart until one is published.

statusHelp.ACTIVE: Currently used to read pH for the chart's product line and batch. Cannot be edited directly.
statusHelp.ARCHIVED: Replaced by a newer chart. For reference only, no longer used for scanning.

chart.stripError: Could not load the color strip
